vibe_rationale: Huge open-access festival with a real independent and alternative core, but mass-market in scale and heavily sponsor-branded, so the culture is diluted.
fit_notes: A month-long program across 562 venues means a brand could run its own hub, wellness or recovery space, or a program strand, and free venue registration keeps entry cheap. The crowd is broad and generic, so breadth dilutes subculture positioning.
